STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_06099_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_06099_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_06099
   (A,
    AND_OUT,
    AVALID,
    B,
    BVALID,
    CLK,
    D,
    OR_OUT,
    P,
    Q,
    QVALID,
    S,
    XOR_OUT);
  input [15:0]A;
  output [15:0]AND_OUT;
  input AVALID;
  input [15:0]B;
  input BVALID;
  input CLK;
  output [15:0]D;
  output [15:0]OR_OUT;
  output [31:0]P;
  output [31:0]Q;
  output QVALID;
  output [15:0]S;
  output [15:0]XOR_OUT;

  wire [31:0]product;
  wire [31:0]quotient;
  wire divide_valid;

  // AND operation
  assign AND_OUT = A & B;

  // OR operation
  assign OR_OUT = A | B;

  // XOR operation
  assign XOR_OUT = A ^ B;

  // ADD operation (S)
  assign S = A + B;

  // ADD operation (D)
  assign D = A + B; // Can be modified if a different operation is needed

  // Multiplication
  assign product = A * B;
  assign P = product;

  // Division
  assign quotient = (B != 16'd0) ? (A / B) : 32'd0;
  assign Q = quotient;
  assign divide_valid = (B != 16'd0) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
  assign QVALID = divide_valid;

endmodule
